PR.title: T-3041: recognize the fort parade ground's native surface
PR.body:
The 1812 fort's parade slab already draws through the native fenced-ground layer. The building loader still required a direct building batch for it, producing a false missing-building error and potentially suppressing dependent furniture. This accounts separately for the two explicitly owned parade grounds only after their real loaded meshes prove finite, nonempty and entirely earth with valid triangles. Direct building counts and boxes remain actual geometry. Failed loads, malformed or empty meshes, mixed earth/sundial geometry and unknown owners retain ordinary presence checks.

Actual validation:

- Local source parts 1–3 passed on unchanged authored tree `44ce86cc`; whole part 4 passed on `fa943206` after the native instrument genuinely measured the new read-only regression. The original isolation-coverage failure remains preserved. Fresh current-dev owner checks and production parade, 54 fort-gate, batch-coalescing and batch-instancing regressions passed.
- Frozen head `05366ebe` passed actual 1812 cards plus a positive native parade-ground GPU hit at both desktop and phone, then existing published 1835 Stage 3 at both sizes: **107 passed, 0 failed each**. All four legs and the whole controller properly reaped every child; all 720 selected inputs, 5887 published members and Git/helper guards remained exact. Both custom legs had zero page/network/console/server errors.
- Root directly reviewed all eight card JPGs. Full Quaife Record and Currey link-only Images credit are visible at both sizes; the full Whistler citation is visible on desktop. The phone source screenshot shows Quaife/Swearingen, with Whistler item 6 off screen; the long roof reason is clipped, at both ends on phone. No complete phone Whistler, whole-long-reason, roof-body or full fort image-match claim.
- Later Lake documentary metadata and the independently reviewed Cobweb aperture increment are normally integrated. Renderer fix, first-fort 1812 data/physical assets, and NE/parade manifest contracts remain unchanged. The Lake audit proves its geometry/function/confidence/yard items unchanged. **The actual 1835 native runs used the older pre-Cobweb scene**, not the current one; scoped carry composes unchanged owned contracts with the coordinator-approved [fixed Cobweb comparison](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/blob/57a69573a54e56f3b25880f7718ff343ea25cd86/evidence/cobweb-castle-2026-11-04/ee8529e-fixed-private-depth-pair/RECOVERY.md). No current whole-scene byte-equivalence or new browser execution is claimed. Fresh current owners/staleness, aperture/parade/fort regressions and metadata checks pass; final required hosted eight-part gate is pending.

This continues existing T-3041 / parent T-2387 and does not close their original image gates. Visible-progress exemption: it removes the actual scene-validation error blocking the owner-adopted north-east pyramid-roof parcel from PR #1685. The ground already rendered. No new photo ticket or restored-ground claim.

[Closed actual runtime and native receipts](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/blob/d2d1a4203849bc597338d6a08a1cbd7da0727a6d/evidence/first-fort-2026-11-04/pr1696-runtime-closed-pass/RECOVERY.md) · [Eight JPGs and bounded direct review](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/blob/f73332e4c9f02ffcea1edb4c0e4343a279448c9f/evidence/first-fort-2026-11-04/pr1696-both-cards-positive-ground-root-reviewed/RECOVERY.md)

head_commit.message:
Merge current Cobweb geometry and fold into the validated parade repair

Preserve current raw documentation and stamped history, current isolation
rows and all own/foreign native readings through the normal merge drivers.
The first fort 1812 data and physical assets, NE/parade manifest contracts,
renderer fix and actual regression are unchanged from the executed source.
One 1818 factor-house input recipe hash changes, not its physical assets.

The actual 1835 native readings ran before this foreign Cobweb increment;
do not claim the current scene was executed or is all-runtime byte-exact.
The coordinator approved scoped composition with the independently viewed
fixed Cobweb pair, retaining its explicit geometric limits. All eleven
fresh owners, staleness, parade, fort, aperture, inventory and metadata
checks pass. No additional browser run or full-fort image match is claimed.

A new actual hosted eight-part gate on this head is required before normal
merge to dev. Original T-3041 and T-2387 image acceptance remains partial.
